session.box_boot_id: dc407ed6-d6b2-4cde-9dc9-3b3a2608066d (the P2 box session, started 15:5xZ 2026-09-24; every P2 comparison is interleaved ABAB inside it; banked P0/P1/Stage-4 figures are context and cross-session evidence only)
session.images: new tags only: rr:p2-pdfium (P2-C) is the only image P2 builds. rr:patched and rr:patched-video are never modified, retagged or removed; their IDs are read back before and after the build and at every chain start and end. rr:p1-tikafix (sha256:35d4b477…, P1-B) and li:video / ws1-llamaindex:x86_64 are used as built.
session.per_leg: steal (/proc/stat at open and close), CPU model, MHz, boot id (the docs driver's P0 session block; the video chain's own files), the percore sampler, and the 1 Hz memory.stat sampler (working/harness/memstat_sampler.py) on the service container, started AFTER the run directory exists; the master verifies the FIRST leg's memstat.jsonl is non-empty and stops everything if it is not (register 55). The memory figure is the SAMPLED peak inside the leg's window.
session.D0: every cell reads back its instances. RocketRide: one task process and one loaded instance per model (P0_ONTOKEN on-token env_probe, pre and post the window) — a violation stops the chain and the master. LlamaIndex: the runner reads warm_workers back and refuses unless it equals the declared worker count (24 in P2-A (1) and the P2-A full run, 1 in the anchor (2)); the container's processes are censused by the driver. The mandate constrains RocketRide; LlamaIndex at 24 workers is the comparator P2-A names, LlamaIndex at one worker / one instance is the single-instance parity target.
session.rulings: A (32 vCPU unconstrained) and C (one workload at a time)
session.retries: a leg that did not complete (non-zero rc without every row recorded) is retried at most twice, then recorded FAILED; a docs leg whose driver verdict is DEGRADED with every row recorded (a document lost to its timeout) is a RESULT and is NOT retried (register 55); the analysis names the lost documents
session.launch: every chain runs detached (box.sh launch); the laptop polls S3 and the log; nothing waits in a session
session.progress_log: PROGRESS_LOG_<n>.md files in this campaign directory, a NEW file per landing; a landed file is never appended to
session.correctness_first: on every changed cell, correctness is decided before any speed figure is reported

floors.rule: an ABAB comparison is readable iff |delta| > max(floor, the spread of each pair); a one-run-each comparison is readable iff |delta| > the floor; spread = |a-b|/mean(a,b)

session.instrumentation: RocketRide docs legs carry the stamp_probe PROFILE stamps (P0 D1: overhead unreadable, +0.15% vs 0.82%; if anything it costs RocketRide) — the P1-B evidence (5.34 docs/s) was measured stamped; LlamaIndex docs legs run the image's own service (untimed), as Stage 4's 5.10 docs/s did. Video legs carry the P1 stamped detect copies on both arms (as P1-A's untraced legs did) and NO tracer.
session.mandate: ONE engine process, ONE pipeline (one token), ONE instance per model; threads unrestricted; anything needing more is OUT OF BOUNDS

hard_dependency_gates.rule: register 55 / P1 lesson 54: any failed build, in-image check or correctness gate STOPS every stage that depends on that image or result; independent stages continue. The master (working/scripts/p2_master.sh) checks each gate's exit status explicitly and records it, one JSON line per gate, in master_gates.jsonl (uploaded after every gate).

gates.G_memstat: after the first leg: its memstat.jsonl exists and has >= 1 row -> else the master STOPS (every later leg depends on the sampler)
gates.G_mandate: any chain exit 9 (a D0 violation) -> the master STOPS
gates.G_build_C: p2_pdfium_build.sh exit 0 (built, base and protected ids unchanged, in-image import-and-parse check passed) -> else P2-C smoke and P2-C full are NOT RUN (reason recorded)
gates.G_node_C: after the first HYBRID and the first PURE leg: the prototype node's own counters (docs, text, fallback, errors, last_error) show docs >= 1 and text >= 1 for that variant -> else P2-C stops (the prototype did not run; P1's failure mode)
gates.G_smoke_A: P2-A smoke gate (below) -> fired queues the P2-A full run; not fired skips only that full run
gates.G_smoke_C_<variant>: P2-C smoke gate per variant (below) -> fired queues that variant's full run
gates.G_manip_B: after the first RR baseline and the first RR COMBINED leg: the in-process read-back shows the manipulation — baseline: debugger loaded (env_probe d0 trace pydevd_loaded true or sys.monitoring tool 'pydevd') and no MALLOC_ARENA_MAX in the task process; COMBINED: debugger NOT loaded (pydevd_loaded false and no sys.monitoring tool) AND MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2 in the detector process's environment (p1_readback.json env) -> else P2-B stops (remaining legs NOT RUN; P2-B UNREADABLE: the cells were not the cells described)

smoke_gate_protocol: every experiment with a full-corpus form runs its smoke stage first; its numeric threshold is fixed HERE; a fired gate queues its full run automatically; a gate that does not fire skips only that full run, records the threshold and the measured value, and the chain continues

budget_and_order.budget: 8 hours from the start of the first leg (the master records P2_DEADLINE_EPOCH = start + 28,800 s in master_gates.jsonl before leg 1). Before every leg the chains check it: a leg in flight finishes; a leg not yet started is recorded NOT_RUN_budget; then the report is written and the box stopped
order: 4 P2-A full run, only if G_smoke_A fired
5 P2-C full run(s), only for variants whose gate fired
budget_and_order.laptop: P2-D runs on the laptop from source while the box measures (no box time)

P2_A_docs_headline.hypothesis: with the P1-B wrapper fix, ONE RocketRide token approaches LlamaIndex's 24-worker optimum on docs/s
P2_A_docs_headline.evidence_before: CROSS-SESSION, therefore HYPOTHESIS only: rr:p1-tikafix full corpus 5.34 docs/s (P1-B, p1b_fix_full) vs LlamaIndex 24 workers C=32 5.10 docs/s (Stage 4)

smoke.(1): the 384 slice (working/results/batchsize_smoke_20260920T113000Z/slice_docs_n384_w25.json; 384 measured + 25 warm-up), ABAB two runs each, in this order: p2a_rr_a (rr:p1-tikafix, ONE token, C=32 continuous), p2a_li_a (LlamaIndex 24 workers, C=32 continuous), p2a_rr_b, p2a_li_b
smoke.(2): per-unit anchor, the 96 slice (working/results/batchsize_main_20260920T160920Z/slice_docs_n96_w25.json), ABAB two runs each: p2a_an_rr_a (rr:p1-tikafix one token, C=8), p2a_an_li_a (LlamaIndex ONE worker, C=8), p2a_an_rr_b, p2a_an_li_b. No full-run form; always runs; reported as a ratio beside max(9.87%, its four spreads), no gate

P2_A_docs_headline.metric: span docs/s = documents answered ok / (max completion - min submit) over the MEASURED rows of the leg (warm-up excluded) — p0_analyse_docs.span_raw, the P0/P1 definition, on both arms

SMOKE_GATE_P2_A.rule: FIRES iff mean(RR span docs/s over p2a_rr_a, p2a_rr_b) >= 0.85 x mean(LI span docs/s over p2a_li_a, p2a_li_b)
SMOKE_GATE_P2_A.reported_beside: the ratio, both arms' noise floors (RR 0.82%, LI 9.87%) and the two within-session replicate spreads

P2_A_docs_headline.KNOWN_BIAS: none of the eleven pathological PDFs is in the 384 slice, and P1-B gained +12.6% on the 384 slice vs +128% on the full corpus, so this gate UNDERSTATES RocketRide. The gate stands as written.

full_run.design: only if the gate fired: ONE full 9,975 run each (slice_docs_n9975_w25.json; 9,975 measured + 25 warm-up), same two arms, same session, RR first: p2a_rr_full (rr:p1-tikafix, one token, C=32, stamped, chunk texts captured — P2-C's full-scale comparator), p2a_li_full (LlamaIndex 24 workers, C=32)
full_run.report: span docs/s; the excluded-straggler view (the same over the documents that are not the eleven); CPU-s/doc; utilisation (engine/service container cores over the window, and host); idle cores (32 - host); idle spin (the driver's measured spin, never added back); the SAMPLED memory peak; lost documents (rows not ok, named); the empty-document set difference both ways (a document is empty on an arm if it is not ok or returns zero chunks; named)
full_run.verdict: delta = RR span docs/s / LI span docs/s - 1 (one run each; readability bar = the larger arm floor, 9.87%). ONE TOKEN EXCEEDS the 24-worker optimum iff delta > +9.87%; MATCHES it within noise iff |delta| <= 9.87%; FALLS SHORT iff delta < -9.87%. 'Matches at full scale' is stated YES iff delta >= -9.87%, else NO — said plainly in the report

P2_A_docs_headline.if_not_fired: the full run is NOT RUN (gate not fired); the report states the measured ratio against 0.85 and the recorded bias

P2_C_parser_rerun.build: rr:p2-pdfium FROM rr:p1-tikafix (a NEW tag; rr:p1-pdfium from P1 is left as it is). pypdfium2 5.13.0 is installed from ~/p0venv (the wheel H6 used; no download) by its dist-info RECORD — every file the wheel installed, including the top-level pypdfium2_cfg module whose absence broke P1 — plus the prototype nodes generated from working/nodes/p2_pdfium_src (P1's template; P2 adds per-document counters with the last error, written after every document). HARD GATE (G_build_C): the build exits 0 only if the engine's own Python inside the image imports pypdfium2 AND pypdfium2_cfg, parses 002_002489.pdf to > 0 characters, and imports both node modules with the right HYBRID flag, and the base and protected image ids are unchanged; otherwise P2-C stops and is reported NOT RUN
P2_C_parser_rerun.hypothesis: with the wrapper fixed, a native parser gains little, because parse is now ~5.5% of document time (P1-B: parse share 0.0551 on the 384 slice, p1b_fix_a/b) and warm pypdfium2 was only 1.06x Tika on the eleven stragglers (H6)

variants.PURE: pypdfium2 only (the pdfium_pure node replaces the Tika parse node)
variants.HYBRID: pypdfium2 first; P1-B's fixed Tika as fallback on empty text or error (the pdfium_hybrid node replays the document's buffered tags to the Tika parse node)

smoke.(i): the eleven stragglers through the pipeline at C=1, stamped (slice_docs_n11_stragglers_w25.json: the eleven in name order + the 384 slice's 25 warm-up documents), ABAB two runs each, in this order: p2c_s_fix_a (rr:p1-tikafix), p2c_s_hyb_a, p2c_s_pure_a (rr:p2-pdfium), p2c_s_fix_b, p2c_s_hyb_b, p2c_s_pure_b. Metric: per-document parse-stage bracket (p0_analyse_docs: engine pipe open -> the parse boundary stamp's last text, the boundary following every parser node), p50 (the true median) over the eleven documents answered ok with all three stamps
smoke.(ii): the 384 slice, C=32, stamped, chunk texts captured, ABAB two runs each: p2c_fix_a, p2c_hyb_a, p2c_pure_a, p2c_fix_b, p2c_hyb_b, p2c_pure_b

SMOKE_GATE_P2_C.per_variant: the variant's full run is queued iff BOTH (a) and (b) hold

(a)_SPEED.rule: T = mean over p2c_s_fix_a/b of the leg's p50 parse bracket over the eleven; spread_T = |T_a - T_b| / mean(T_a, T_b); V = the same mean for the variant. (a) HOLDS iff (T - V) / T > spread_T, i.e. the variant's p50 is lower than fixed Tika's by more than fixed Tika's own within-session replicate spread on that metric
(a)_SPEED.threshold: spread_T (measured in session; fixed by this rule, not by a number chosen after the data)
(a)_SPEED.degenerate: if any of the six legs has fewer than 6 of the eleven with all stamps, (a) is NOT EVALUABLE and does not hold (recorded)

(b)_COVERAGE.rule: on the 384 slice, over the measured documents: L_V = {documents with non-whitespace joined chunk text in at least one of p2c_fix_a/b} INTERSECT {documents that, in at least one of the variant's two runs, are not ok, return zero chunks, or return whitespace-only joined text}. (b) HOLDS iff L_V is empty (named if not)

SMOKE_GATE_P2_C.EXPECTED_recorded_not_assumed: PURE likely fails (b) on H6's evidence (empty on 5 documents Tika extracts); HYBRID passes (b) by construction and may fail (a)
SMOKE_GATE_P2_C.KNOWN_BIAS: (a) is measured on the eleven tail documents at C=1 — the documents where P1-B already removed the pathology — so it ranks the parse bracket on the tail, not on typical documents (the 384 ABAB reports typical-document speed, ungated); HYBRID pays PDFium AND Tika on every fallback document, which (a) includes. (b) is decided on the 384 slice, which holds none of the eleven. Recorded; the gate stands as written.

full_run.design: per variant whose gate fired, ONE full 9,975 run (stamped, texts captured): p2c_hyb_full / p2c_pure_full. The comparator is P2-A's RR full leg (p2a_rr_full, same image rr:p1-tikafix, stamped, texts) if it ran; otherwise ONE fixed-Tika full leg p2c_fix_full runs first in this session
full_run.correctness_first: against fixed Tika at full scale, P1-C's definitions unchanged: text = a document's chunk texts as returned, joined in order; empty = not ok or zero chunks or whitespace-only; empty documents and the named set difference both ways; per-document character ratio and Sorensen-Dice similarity of whitespace-token multisets (after collapsing whitespace) as distributions (min, p5, p25, p50, p75, p95); failures named. A variant is ADOPTABLE iff it is empty on no document the fixed-Tika run recovers
full_run.then: speed (span docs/s, one run each: readable iff |delta| > 0.82%), the excluded-straggler view, the SAMPLED memory peak, the parse stage's share of run total

P2_C_parser_rerun.verdict: the hypothesis 'a native parser gains little' is judged against LITTLE = a full-corpus docs/s gain no larger than +5.83% (1/(1-0.0551) - 1: the Amdahl bound of P1-B's fixed parse share on the 384 slice, fixed here). SUPPORTED iff no variant is both ADOPTABLE and faster than fixed Tika at full scale by more than 5.83% (readable beyond 0.82%) — including the case where no variant's smoke gate fires; NOT SUPPORTED iff some ADOPTABLE variant is faster by more than 5.83%. Per variant the report states: gate (a) value vs threshold, gate (b) set, full-run correctness, then speed
P2_C_parser_rerun.if_build_fails: P2-C NOT RUN (build or in-image check failed) — reported with the check's output; no leg runs on the image

P2_B_video_configuration_suspects_untrac.hypothesis: the per-instance video gap is caused by process configuration, not the model
P2_B_video_configuration_suspects_untrac.evidence_before: P1-A untraced legs (e2_*_off_*): forward pass 0.382 vs 0.283 s/frame at T=4, caller on-CPU 60% vs 75%, identical pool/affinity read-backs; the read-backs differ only in: debugger attached in RocketRide only (pydevd), MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2 in LlamaIndex only, RocketRide's detector process 182 OS threads vs 34
P2_B_video_configuration_suspects_untrac.design: the 16-video AMI slice (the first 16 rows of ~/parity-bench-video/working/video/ami_video_manifest.jsonl), K=16, T=4 (six thread variables = 4), the P1 stamped detect copies on every leg, NO tracer; interleaved ABAB two runs each, in this order: p2b_rr_base_a, p2b_rr_comb_a, p2b_li_a, p2b_rr_base_b, p2b_rr_comb_b, p2b_li_b

cells.rr_base: rr:patched-video, one token (P0_ONTOKEN), exactly the P1-A untraced RocketRide leg
cells.rr_comb: COMBINED: the same image and token, launched without the debugger by the H7 method (noDebug=True added to the SDK's execute call — driver_video.py P2_NODEBUG=1, the docs driver's BSZ_NODEBUG mechanism, proven in P0 H7 legs: pydevd_loaded false) AND MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2 in the container's environment (docker run -e)
cells.li_ref: li:video, ONE instance, one worker (the P1-A LlamaIndex leg)

P2_B_video_configuration_suspects_untrac.readback_per_leg: in-process: debugger present (env_probe d0 trace: pydevd_loaded / debugpy_loaded / sys.monitoring tools, pre and post; the stamped copy's p1_readback.json monitoring_tools and gettrace), the malloc environment (p1_readback.json env MALLOC_*), and the detector process's OS thread count (p1_readback.json os_threads; env_probe proc_threads)
P2_B_video_configuration_suspects_untrac.CORRECTNESS_GATE: RR COMBINED must be chunk-identical to RR baseline on 16/16 videos in BOTH pairs (p2b_rr_comb_a vs p2b_rr_base_a, p2b_rr_comb_b vs p2b_rr_base_b; per-video chunk hashes AND frame scores, p0_analyse_video.identity). If not: P2-B is reported OUTPUT-CHANGING and NO speed verdict is given

metrics.PRIMARY: frames/s = total frames / (last done - first admit) over the measured videos (p0_analyse_video.load; the P0 V1 / P1-D definition)
metrics.SECONDARY_mechanism: F = mean forward wall per frame over the measured frames (the last N stamp rows by wall time, N = the export's frames; p1_analyse_e2), and the caller on-CPU share (sum thread CPU / sum forward wall)

reading.definitions: per cell, the mean of its two legs and its spread; gap = fps(li_ref) - fps(rr_base); closure = (fps(rr_comb) - fps(rr_base)) / gap
reading.precondition: the gap is readable in this session iff (fps(li_ref) / fps(rr_base) - 1) > max(0.82%, spread(li_ref), spread(rr_base)); otherwise 'the gap did not reproduce in session' and no reading
reading.CONFIGURATION_EXPLAINS_THE_GAP: iff the correctness gate passes AND closure >= 0.5 AND (fps(rr_comb) / fps(rr_base) - 1) > max(0.82%, spread(rr_base), spread(rr_comb)) -> record it and design the single-knob decomposition (noDebug alone, MALLOC_ARENA_MAX alone) for P3
reading.otherwise: record which differences are ruled out at this strength (the debugger and the malloc arena setting, jointly) and name the next suspects from the read-backs (e.g. the detector process's thread population, env and pool fields that still differ)
reading.secondary: the same closure computed on F (forward per frame) is reported beside, labelled mechanism; the verdict follows the PRIMARY metric

P2_B_video_configuration_suspects_untrac.not_in_P2: the 168-video confirmation is deferred to P3 with its own gate

P2_D_laptop_source_only.evidence: SOURCE (file:line read) vs UNVERIFIED (inference), labelled per claim

deliverable: one P2 report: a gate table (threshold, measured value, fired or not, known bias); correctness before speed for every changed cell; the P2-A verdict stated plainly; the P2-B and P2-C verdicts; the embedding trace and the ticket draft; everything NOT RUN with its reason; the CloudTrail finding.
